out_items.name: Hot and cold water available, adequate pressure

violations.title: Hot Water Capacity to Meet Peak Demands
violations.observation: The permit holder has removed the water heater previously approved by the Health Department. The current water heater does not have the capacity to meet the hourly peak hot water demands of the food establishment. The current peak hot water demand is 75 gallons/hour at an 80 degree F rise.
violations.corrective_action: Within 30 days, the permit holder shall replace or upgrade the water heater with a unit that meets the following design and capacity requirements: (1) Commercial grade, (2) Minimum of 50 gallon storage tank, (3) Minimum recovery rate of 75 gph at an 80 degree rise (4) Specifications and installation meet National Sanitation Foundation (NSF) Standard 5. The permit holder shall provide the Health Department with the specifications (cut sheet) for the replacement water heater and obtain approval prior to purchase and installation. Please be reminded that equipment replacement or addition is not allowed without prior approval by the Health Department.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Design Features
violations.observation: 1) The backflow prevention device installed on the mop sink is severely corroded and must be replaced. 2) The splitter valve on the mop sink must be removed or replaced with a splitter valve designed for that application.
violations.corrective_action: 1) Replace the corroded backflow prevention device. A backflow or back siphonage prevention device installed on a water supply system shall meet American Society of Sanitary Engineering (A.S.S.E.) standards for construction, installation, maintenance, inspection, and testing for that specific application and type of device. 2) Remove or replace splitter valve with one that is designed to be used in sequence with and following a backflow prevention device.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed that the following is not maintained in good repair. 1) Base of side door is severely corroded. 2) The self closing mechanism for the side door is damaged. 3) There is no screened door on the side door.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. 1) Repair/ replace the damaged base of the side door and the self - losing mechanism. 2) Install a tight fitting screen door on the side door.
